question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

There is no need to jump to a ________ so soon.
solution:
The correct answer is: **conclusion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"resistance"** means the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument. (प्रतिकार)

 
 
• **Example: **There was strong resistance from the locals to the new policy.
 
 
 
• **"Conclusion" **means the end or finish of an event, process, or text; a judgment or decision reached by reasoning. (निष्कर्ष)
 
 
• **Example: **After much thought, he came to the conclusion that it was best to move on.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **conclusion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Resistance **(प्रतिकार): The refusal to accept or comply with something.

 
 
• **Example:** There was strong resistance from the locals to the new policy.
 
 
 
• **Incision **(चीर): A surgical cut made in skin or flesh.
 
 
• **Example: **The surgeon made a small incision to remove the tumor.
 
 
 
• **Finale** (अंतिम चरण): The last part of a piece of music, a performance, or a public event.
 
 
• **Example:** The fireworks were a spectacular finale to the show.
